name: index_reduce
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::index_reduce(Tensor self, int dim, Tensor index, Tensor source, str reduce, *, bool include_self=True) -> Tensor. Applies prod, mean, amax, or amin from source into a functional result. Tests cover include_self, negative dimensions, int32/int64 indices, duplicate and empty indices, noncontiguous tensors, invalid reductions, input non-mutation, and shared index_reduce_ identity coverage.
